title: Audi Sport — introductory loop

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Provide a concise introduction to sub-brand character so the viewer can recognize the shift before watching the full explanation.
strategic_value: A quick transition from Audi rings to Audi Sport, red fields and forceful copy can establish family and difference together.
demonstration: The 15.96-second loop moves from white rings to Audi Sport, compares color fields and places Make your statement and Feel the powerful moment over moving images.
practical_value: Compare the short autoplay sequence with the fuller Audi Sport narrative AU11.

content_islands.name: Signature transition
content_islands.spec: Move from parent rings to the Audi Sport wordmark and slanted symbol.

content_islands.name: Color shift
content_islands.spec: Show the neutral/red family followed by a red-dominant composition.

content_islands.name: Statement sequence
content_islands.spec: Overlay large uppercase phrases on driving and people footage before returning to the rings.

reference_purposes.Expression: The loop combines the sub-brand signature, red fields and emphatic campaign statements.
reference_purposes.Application: This is the case study’s separate autoplay introduction to the full Audi Sport film.
